correctness.rationale: An exact-cover search for the pairs terminates and branches uniquely for each actual design. An independent reproduction normalized the four blocks through 0 to a single perfect matching of the other eight points, found eight completions, and relabelled these over all 105 matchings to give 840 distinct systems. Indexing six-block subsets detected every pair with at least six blocks in common, and every distinct such pair had exactly six in common. Its neighborhood at each vertex was exactly the 36 distinct transposition images. Breadth-first search gave all seven intersection/multiplicity/distance rows and reaches all 840 designs; conjugation invariance of the generating transpositions and transitivity transfer the rooted table to all pairs. An independently written all-root enumeration agreed. The standard affine plane is a system because each distinct pair has a unique third point on its line. Its 432 affine automorphisms are all stabilizers by orbit–stabilizer, so the group and coset model follow, and a transposition step changes the six blocks containing exactly one of the swapped points. The minimum coset word length is 9 minus the largest number of cycles in a representative, since a transposition changes the cycle count by one and every length-k cycle decomposes into k−1 swaps. The largest intersection of distinct systems is six, so the described trade volume is also the smallest nonzero one in this order. The independent fixed-matching reproduction is python3 /workspace/branches/reproduce.py 3; source scripts were inspected, not executed.
